host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: ls; ls studies studies/*; ls pinned-source 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p athena-cap-study rules::tests -- --nocapture 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cap-study 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-context 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; git status --short
cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test mirrors --quiet 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p xtask --test policy --quiet 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; ls; ls studies studies/*; wc -l crates/athena-cap-study/src/*.rs xtask/tests/policy.rs; cat crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/producer.md; cat crates/athena-cap-study/Cargo.toml; ls pinned-source 2>&1 | head -3; env | grep ATHENA_PIN

git status --short; ls; ls studies studies/*; wc -l crates/athena-cap-study/src/*.rs xtask/tests/policy.rs; cat crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/producer.md; cat crates/athena-cap-study/Cargo.toml; ls pinned-source 2>&1; env | grep ATHENA_PIN
grep -n "pub fn validate\|^#\[cfg(test)\]\|^mod tests\|^    fn \|^    #\[test\]" crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs | tail -80
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p athena-cap-study rules::tests -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tail -60
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-context 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed"
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-context 2>&1 | tail -n 3
cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; echo CLIPPY_EXIT=$?
